pages.title: Auswertungen
pages.purpose: Read KPIs per area for a period (members, events & door, revenue, invoices, cash book, shifts, more), each section only for those who may see it.

urlState.meaning: preset: 30d | month | last_month | quarter | year | last_year

sections.title: Zeitraum

fields.name: p
fields.label: Letzte 30 Tage · Dieser Monat · Letzter Monat · Dieses Quartal · Dieses Jahr · Letztes Jahr

sections.notes: Button 'Anzeigen' (reports.show) submits a GET form to /reports.

sections.title: Mitglieder
sections.notes: KPI tiles: Aktive Mitglieder, Eintritte, Austritte, Pausiert, Beitragsfrei, dues paid / open / overdue (red, with people count); 'Stand heute' hints. Bars per membership type; grouped bars joined/left per month (recharts, charts.tsx).

sections.title: Veranstaltungen & Einlass
sections.notes: KPI tiles: Veranstaltungen, Tickets verkauft, Ticketumsatz, Eingelassen, mit Ticket / Mitglieder / Gäste; bars 'Eingelassene Mitglieder nach Mitgliedsart'; stacked bars 'Eingelassen pro Veranstaltung'. Empty: 'Keine Veranstaltungen in diesem Zeitraum.' Columns depend on tickets/guestlists modules.

sections.title: Umsatz
sections.notes: Tiles: Eingegangen, Bezahlte Bestellungen, one tile per source ('davon Tickets' …; unknown source keys are shown raw).

sections.title: Rechnungen
sections.notes: Tiles: Ausgestellt (+ count), Bezahlt, Offen (Stand heute), Überfällig (red).

sections.title: Kassenbuch
sections.notes: Tiles: Einnahmen, Ausgaben, Überschuss (red when negative), one balance tile per account; grouped bars by sphere.

sections.title: Schichten
sections.notes: Tiles: Schichten, Besetzt (% + 'n von m Plätzen'), Gearbeitete Stunden.

sections.title: Weitere Zahlen
sections.notes: Tiles: Neue Kontakte, Formular-Einsendungen, Kursteilnahmen, E-Mails verschickt (+ delivery rate), Unzustellbar / Spam (red).

pages.phone: Tiles in 2 columns; charts and event table stack; 6 preset chips wrap over several lines.
uxNotes: Six presets in a hand-built chip nav; docs/design/app.md caps <Segments> at 5 items.
KPI tiles link nowhere (e.g. 'Überfällig' does not open /invoices?status=overdue, open dues do not open Beiträge): numbers are dead ends except the event titles.
Payment source labels exist only for tickets/members/invoices/guestlists; shop and test revenue tiles show the raw key ('shop', 'test').
Sections are FormCards (form groups) used as report panels; no export of any report.
Custom range uses a SubmitButton (spinner) for a plain GET navigation.
Section order and naming differ from the nav: 'Umsatz' summarises Zahlungen, 'Veranstaltungen & Einlass' vs nav 'Events'.

redesign.job: Read the key numbers of a period across areas and jump to the list behind any number.
redesign.phone: Toolbar: Zeitraum dropdown (6 presets as an action sheet), then Von/Bis + Anzeigen wrapping below. Sections with small headings; Stats 2 per row, each tile a link; charts full width; event table as cards.
redesign.desktop: Toolbar: Zeitraum dropdown · Von · Bis · Anzeigen. Sections (Section component, not form cards) with <Stats> rows; charts side by side; event table.
moves: 6 preset chips → Zeitraum dropdown (DropdownMenu of links, action sheet on phones), label = current preset or 'Eigener Zeitraum'

Kpi tiles → <Stat> with href where a list exists: members → /members, dues open/overdue → /members/dues, events → /events, payments → /payments?status=paid (per source ?source=), invoices issued → /invoices?kind=invoice, open → ?status=sent, overdue → ?status=overdue, paid → ?status=paid, cash book → /cashbook, shifts → /shifts, hours → /shifts/hours, contacts → /contacts, forms → /forms, courses → /courses, email → /email/log; only when the module is on and the person may open it
payment source labels: raw keys ('shop', 'test') → human labels (davon Shop, davon Testzahlungen; unknown keys fall back to payments.sources.*)
charts (members by type, joined/left per month, admitted per event, cash book by sphere) → unchanged
event table (link → /events/<id>) → rowHref instead of a link inside the first cell
Weitere Zahlen tiles → unchanged content, linked
redesign.kept: uxNote 3 partly: sections are Section blocks now; an export of the report is not built. 'Umsatz' keeps its name (it sums payments of all sources).

sweep.note: Phone: the Von/Bis/Anzeigen row pushed the whole page sideways (stats and charts clipped on the right): the range form is a 2-column grid with a full-width Anzeigen (default control height, was sm) on phones; charts sit in minmax(0,1fr) grids so they can't widen the page; Y axis width auto (money values like 1.260 were clipped to '60'); series colours skip --chart-2 next to --chart-1 (both blue: Einnahmen and Ausgaben looked the same).
